embedding.description: shared projected card token + combat hand cost/damage/block/select context (upgrade count=0, select mask=0)

Bash.effect_zh: 造成8/10点伤害。施加2/3层易伤。

Anger.effect_en: Deal 6/8 damage. Add a copy to the discard pile.
Anger.effect_zh: 造成6/8点伤害。将一张本牌的复制加入弃牌堆。

Armaments.effect_en: Gain 5 Block. Upgrade one/all cards in hand for this combat.
Armaments.effect_zh: 获得5点格挡。本场战斗中升级手牌中的一张/所有牌。

Body Slam.effect_en: Deal damage equal to current Block.
Body Slam.effect_zh: 造成等同于当前格挡值的伤害。

Clash.effect_en: Playable only if every card in hand is an Attack. Deal 14/18 damage.
Clash.effect_zh: 仅当所有手牌均为攻击牌时可打出。造成14/18点伤害。

Cleave.effect_zh: 对所有敌人造成8/11点伤害。

Clothesline.effect_zh: 造成12/14点伤害。施加2/3层虚弱。

Flex.effect_en: Gain 2/4 Strength; lose it at end of turn.
Flex.effect_zh: 获得2/4点力量，并在回合结束时失去这些力量。

Havoc.effect_en: Play the top draw-pile card and Exhaust it.
Havoc.effect_zh: 打出抽牌堆顶牌并将其消耗。

Headbutt.effect_en: Deal 9/12 damage. Put a discard-pile card on top of draw pile.
Headbutt.effect_zh: 造成9/12点伤害。将弃牌堆中的一张牌置于抽牌堆顶。

Heavy Blade.effect_en: Deal 14 damage. Strength affects it 3/5 times.
Heavy Blade.effect_zh: 造成14点伤害。力量对本牌生效3/5倍。

Iron Wave.effect_zh: 获得5/7点格挡。造成5/7点伤害。

Perfected Strike.effect_en: Deal 6 damage, plus 2/3 per card containing 'Strike'.
Perfected Strike.effect_zh: 造成6点伤害。每张名称中含“打击”的牌使伤害增加2/3点。

Sword Boomerang.effect_en: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy 3/4 times.
Sword Boomerang.effect_zh: 对随机敌人造成3点伤害，共3/4次。

Thunderclap.effect_en: Deal 4/7 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable to all enemies.
Thunderclap.effect_zh: 对所有敌人造成4/7点伤害并施加1层易伤。

True Grit.effect_en: Gain 7/9 Block. Exhaust one random/chosen card.
True Grit.effect_zh: 获得7/9点格挡。随机/选择消耗一张牌。

Warcry.effect_en: Draw 1/2 cards. Put a hand card on top of draw pile. Exhaust.
Warcry.effect_zh: 抽1/2张牌。将一张手牌置于抽牌堆顶。消耗。

Wild Strike.effect_en: Deal 12/17 damage. Shuffle a Wound into draw pile.
Wild Strike.effect_zh: 造成12/17点伤害。将一张伤口洗入抽牌堆。

Battle Trance.effect_en: Draw 3/4 cards. Cannot draw more cards this turn.
Battle Trance.effect_zh: 抽3/4张牌。本回合不能再抽牌。

Blood For Blood.effect_en: Costs 1 less each time HP is lost this combat. Deal 18/22 damage.
Blood For Blood.effect_zh: 本场战斗中每次失去生命，费用降低1。造成18/22点伤害。

Bloodletting.effect_zh: 失去3点生命。获得2/3点能量。

Combust.effect_en: At end of turn lose 1 HP and deal 5/7 damage to all enemies.
Combust.effect_zh: 回合结束时失去1点生命，并对所有敌人造成5/7点伤害。

Dark Embrace.effect_en: Whenever a card is Exhausted, draw 1 card.
Dark Embrace.effect_zh: 每当一张牌被消耗时，抽1张牌。

Dropkick.effect_en: Deal 5/8 damage. If target is Vulnerable, gain 1 Energy and draw 1.
Dropkick.effect_zh: 造成5/8点伤害。若目标有易伤，获得1点能量并抽1张牌。

Dual Wield.effect_en: Choose an Attack or Power; add 1/2 copies to hand.
Dual Wield.effect_zh: 选择一张攻击牌或能力牌，将1/2张复制加入手牌。

Evolve.effect_en: Whenever a Status is drawn, draw 1/2 additional cards.
Evolve.effect_zh: 每当抽到状态牌时，额外抽1/2张牌。

Feel No Pain.effect_en: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain 3/4 Block.
Feel No Pain.effect_zh: 每当一张牌被消耗时，获得3/4点格挡。

Fire Breathing.effect_en: When a Status or Curse is drawn, deal 6/10 damage to all enemies.
Fire Breathing.effect_zh: 每当抽到状态牌或诅咒牌时，对所有敌人造成6/10点伤害。

Flame Barrier.effect_en: Gain 12/16 Block. This turn, attackers take 4/6 damage.
Flame Barrier.effect_zh: 获得12/16点格挡。本回合每次受到攻击时，对攻击者造成4/6点伤害。

Hemokinesis.effect_zh: 失去2点生命。造成15/20点伤害。

Infernal Blade.effect_en: Add a random Attack to hand; it costs 0 this turn. Exhaust.
Infernal Blade.effect_zh: 将一张随机攻击牌加入手牌；其本回合费用为0。消耗。

Intimidate.effect_en: Apply 1/2 Weak to all enemies. Exhaust.
Intimidate.effect_zh: 对所有敌人施加1/2层虚弱。消耗。

Metallicize.effect_en: At end of turn, gain 3/4 Block.
Metallicize.effect_zh: 回合结束时获得3/4点格挡。

Power Through.effect_en: Add 2 Wounds to hand. Gain 15/20 Block.
Power Through.effect_zh: 将2张伤口加入手牌。获得15/20点格挡。

Rage.effect_en: This turn, gain 3/5 Block whenever an Attack is played.
Rage.effect_zh: 本回合每打出一张攻击牌，获得3/5点格挡。

Rampage.effect_en: Deal 8 damage. Increase this card's damage by 5/8 this combat.
Rampage.effect_zh: 造成8点伤害。本场战斗中本牌每次打出后伤害增加5/8点。

Reckless Charge.effect_en: Deal 7/10 damage. Shuffle a Dazed into draw pile.
Reckless Charge.effect_zh: 造成7/10点伤害。将一张晕眩洗入抽牌堆。

Rupture.effect_en: Whenever a card causes HP loss, gain 1/2 Strength.
Rupture.effect_zh: 每当因卡牌效果失去生命时，获得1/2点力量。

Searing Blow.effect_en: Deal 12/16 damage. Can be upgraded repeatedly.
Searing Blow.effect_zh: 造成12/16点伤害。可重复升级。

Second Wind.effect_en: Exhaust all non-Attacks in hand; gain 5/7 Block per card.
Second Wind.effect_zh: 消耗手牌中所有非攻击牌；每张获得5/7点格挡。

Sentinel.effect_en: Gain 5/8 Block. If Exhausted, gain 2/3 Energy.
Sentinel.effect_zh: 获得5/8点格挡。若本牌被消耗，获得2/3点能量。

Sever Soul.effect_en: Exhaust all non-Attacks in hand. Deal 16/22 damage.
Sever Soul.effect_zh: 消耗手牌中所有非攻击牌。造成16/22点伤害。

Shockwave.effect_en: Apply 3/5 Weak and Vulnerable to all enemies. Exhaust.
Shockwave.effect_zh: 对所有敌人施加3/5层虚弱和易伤。消耗。

Spot Weakness.effect_en: If target intends to attack, gain 3/4 Strength.
Spot Weakness.effect_zh: 若目标意图攻击，获得3/4点力量。

Uppercut.effect_en: Deal 13 damage. Apply 1/2 Weak and 1/2 Vulnerable.
Uppercut.effect_zh: 造成13点伤害。施加1/2层虚弱和1/2层易伤。

Whirlwind.effect_en: Deal 5/8 damage to all enemies X times.
Whirlwind.effect_zh: 对所有敌人造成X次5/8点伤害。

Barricade.effect_en: Block is not removed at start of turn.
Barricade.effect_zh: 回合开始时不再失去格挡。

Berserk.effect_en: Gain 2/1 Vulnerable. At start of turn, gain 1 Energy.
Berserk.effect_zh: 获得2/1层易伤。每回合开始时获得1点能量。

Brutality.effect_en: Upgraded is Innate. At start of turn lose 1 HP and draw 1.
Brutality.effect_zh: 升级后固有。每回合开始时失去1点生命并抽1张牌。

Corruption.effect_en: Skills cost 0 and are Exhausted when played.
Corruption.effect_zh: 技能牌费用变为0，但打出后会被消耗。

Demon Form.effect_en: At start of turn, gain 2/3 Strength.
Demon Form.effect_zh: 每回合开始时获得2/3点力量。

Double Tap.effect_en: This turn, the next 1/2 Attacks are played twice.
Double Tap.effect_zh: 本回合接下来1/2张攻击牌会打出两次。

Exhume.effect_en: Put a non-Exhume card from Exhaust pile into hand. Exhaust.
Exhume.effect_zh: 从消耗堆选择一张非发掘牌加入手牌。消耗。

Feed.effect_en: Deal 10/12 damage. Fatal: gain 3/4 Max HP. Exhaust.
Feed.effect_zh: 造成10/12点伤害。致命：最大生命增加3/4。消耗。

Fiend Fire.effect_en: Exhaust the rest of hand; deal 7/10 damage per card. Exhaust.
Fiend Fire.effect_zh: 消耗其余所有手牌；每张造成7/10点伤害。消耗。

Immolate.effect_en: Deal 21/28 damage to all enemies. Add a Burn to discard pile.
Immolate.effect_zh: 对所有敌人造成21/28点伤害。将一张灼伤加入弃牌堆。

Juggernaut.effect_en: Whenever Block is gained, deal 5/7 damage to a random enemy.
Juggernaut.effect_zh: 每当获得格挡时，对随机敌人造成5/7点伤害。

Limit Break.effect_en: Double Strength. Base Exhausts; upgraded does not.
Limit Break.effect_zh: 使力量翻倍。未升级时消耗；升级后不消耗。

Offering.effect_en: Lose 6 HP. Gain 2 Energy. Draw 3/5 cards. Exhaust.
Offering.effect_zh: 失去6点生命。获得2点能量。抽3/5张牌。消耗。

Reaper.effect_en: Deal 4/5 damage to all enemies; heal unblocked damage. Exhaust.
Reaper.effect_zh: 对所有敌人造成4/5点伤害；回复等同于未被格挡伤害的生命。消耗。

Burn.effect_en: Unplayable. At end of turn, take 2 damage (4 for Burn+).
Burn.effect_zh: 无法打出。回合结束时受到2点伤害；灼伤+为4点。

Void.effect_en: Unplayable. Ethereal. When drawn, lose 1 Energy.
Void.effect_zh: 无法打出。虚无。抽到时失去1点能量。
